description: Source code for an Android shared audio decoder implementation, including initialization, decoding, output processing, and error handling.

classes.name: AudioDecoder
classes.description: Class responsible for decoding audio streams, managing buffers, and output processing.

methods.name: AudioDecoder
methods.description: Constructor initializing the audio decoder with stream info, DRM, and flush options.

methods.name: Initialize
methods.description: Sets up output and error callbacks, and initializes the media decoder.

methods.name: Decode
methods.description: Feeds input buffers into the decoder and schedules output processing.

methods.name: WriteEndOfStream
methods.description: Signals end of stream to the decoder.

methods.name: Read
methods.description: Retrieves decoded audio data and updates sample rate.

methods.name: Reset
methods.description: Resets the decoder state, reinitializes if needed, and clears buffers.

methods.name: InitializeCodec
methods.description: Creates and validates the media decoder instance.

methods.name: ProcessOutputBuffer
methods.description: Processes decoded output buffers, handles format adjustments, and manages end-of-stream.

methods.name: RefreshOutputFormat
methods.description: Updates output format parameters from the media codec.
